#!/bin/bash
grep -rn "\.GetUser(" --include="*.go" . | grep -v "proto/gen" | grep -v ".pb.go" | grep -v "Service.GetUser" | while read line; do
  file=$(echo "$line" | cut -d: -f1)
  linenum=$(echo "$line" | cut -d: -f2)
  content=$(echo "$line" | cut -d: -f3-)
  
  # Get the function name by looking backwards from this line
  func_name=$(awk -v target="$linenum" '/^func / { last=$0; last_line=NR } NR==target { print last; exit }' "$file")
  
  if [ ! -z "$func_name" ]; then
    echo "$file:$func_name"
  fi
done | sort -u
EOF
bash /tmp/find_callers.sh
